source.aggressor_rule: is_buyer_maker=false => aggressive buy; is_buyer_maker=true => aggressive sell

decision_clock.reason: Use complete UTC daily trade archives and avoid partial-day/post-cutoff ambiguity.

windows.current: the 7 complete UTC calendar days immediately preceding decision_at
windows.previous: the 7 complete UTC calendar days immediately preceding the current window
windows.coverage_rule: all 14 expected dates must have checksum-verified non-empty raw trade archives; missing/duplicate days fail closed rather than becoming zero flow

features.quote_notional_usd_proxy: sum raw quote_quantity within each 7d window; USDT quote notional is treated as USD-like venue quote notional, not a universal dollar-volume measure
features.trade_count: count unique raw trades within each 7d window
features.current_window_return: last current-window raw trade price / first current-window raw trade price - 1

scientific_boundaries: These features measure venue spot participation/aggressor imbalance, not order-book depth, spread or guaranteed execution quality.
Do not use futures flow as a substitute for spot flow.
Do not infer missing archives as zero activity.
Do not choose windows, fields or thresholds after seeing 2x outcomes.
Do not use current symbol membership to reconstruct historical eligibility.
Do not allow this feature family to alter Cohort 001 baseline membership after outcomes are opened; it is an optional frozen precursor family with its own coverage mask.
A large aggressive-buy share may be coincident/lagging rather than leading; incremental lift versus simple momentum/liquidity baselines must be tested before any predictive claim.
